ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I’m more interested in practical camera and device accessories than a display for video calling.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don’t currently have a clear use for a dedicated Alexa display.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I’d try streaming on my Samsung TV, although its 720p screen would not benefit from 4K.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My power-strip purchases suggest a need for extra outlets, but I have no current need for Alexa automation.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet with Alexa Hands-Free, 10.1" 1080p Full HD Display, 32 GB, Marine Blue (Previous Generation - 7th); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger screen interests me after using a Fire 7, but I’d choose the 64 GB option on this page.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My car accessories support mounting and connecting devices; they don’t give me a reason to add Alexa.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I’d choose this as a possible Fire 7 upgrade for the larger screen and additional storage.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: HD streaming suits my TV, but I’d only choose one streaming stick this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice-controlled speaker doesn’t address the camera, storage, or connection needs reflected in my purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I’m not currently looking for an Alexa speaker, so I’d skip this.
